First, note that time zones as we know them did not exist in 1315.  
But if we treat this as a modern time zone conversion ignoring historical changes:  
Asia/Shanghai = UTC+8, Europe/London = UTC+1 (or UTC+0 in winter, but July is summer daylight saving? Actually UK uses BST in summer = UTC+1).  

5 PM = 17:00 Shanghai time (UTC+8)  
UTC = 17:00 - 8 hours = 09:00 UTC  
London (BST, UTC+1) = 09:00 + 1 hour = 10:00  

Same date: July 8.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 10:00
